Local Ordi 99-3 Disorderly Cond

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA, AND IT 1S HEREBY ORDAINED BY AUTHORITY OF SAME, AS FOLLOWS:

A person commits the offense of disorderly conduct when such person commits any of the following:

- (1) Acts in a violent or tumultuous manner toward another person whereby such person is placed in reasonable fear of the safety of such person’s life, limb, or health;

- (2) Acts in a violent or tumultuous manner toward another person whereby the property of such person is placed in danger of being damaged or destroyed;

- (3) Without provocation, uses to or of another person in such other person’s presence, opprobrious or abusive words which by their very utterance tend to incite to an immediate breach of the peace, that is to say, words which as a matter of common knowledge and under ordinary circumstances will, when used to or of another person in such other person’s presence, naturally tend to provoke violent resentment, that is, words commonly “fighting words”; or

- (4) Without provocation, uses obscene and vulgar or profane language in the presence of or by telephone to a person under the age of 14 years which threatens an immediate breach of the peace.

Any person who commits the offense of disorderly conduct shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. Rate schedule:

Ist Offense $1,172.00 + 16 hours community service 2nd Offense $1,750.00 + 40 hours community service

APPROVED AND ADOPTED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA, THIS THE 11TH DAY OF JANUARY, 2010.

Local Ordinance 99-8 Disorderly House

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA, AND IT IS HEREBY ORDAINED BY AUTHORITY OF SAME, AS FOLLOWS:

A person who keeps and maintains, either by himself or others, a common, ill-governed, and disorderly house, to the encouragement of gaming, drinking, or other misbehavior, or to the common disturbance of the neighborhood or disorderly citizens, within the jurisdiction of the Pine Mountain Police Department within the State of Georgia shall, upon conviction thereof, be punished by a fine of not more than $1,000.00 and/or more than six months in jail.

APPROVED AND ADOPTED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA, THIS THE 9TH DAY OF MAY, 2011.
